Nico Echavarria captures his second victory on the PGA TOUR after winning the 2024 ZOZO CHAMPIONSHIP. Echavarria shot rounds of 64-64-65-67 to finish 20-under.

Nick Dunlap Wins The American Express 2024

Nick Dunlap becomes the first amateur to win on the PGA TOUR since 1991 with his victory at The American Express 2024. The University of Alabama sophomore is the second-youngest winner on TOUR in the last 90 years.

Scottie Scheffler Wins THE PLAYERS 2024

Scottie Scheffler makes history after winning THE PLAYERS Championship 2024, becoming the first player to win the event back-to-back. Scheffler captures his second victory of 2024 and eighth career win.
